english: Let $\overrightarrow{a}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k}$ and let $\overrightarrow{r}$ be a vector satisfying $\overrightarrow{r}+\overrightarrow{a}\times\left(\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{r}\right)=-11\hat{i}-7\hat{j}+12\hat{k}$. Then the value of $\left|\overrightarrow{r}\times\overrightarrow{a}\right|^{2}$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $\overrightarrow{a}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k}$ है तथा $\overrightarrow{r}$ एक ऐसा सदिश है जो $\overrightarrow{r}+\overrightarrow{a}\times\left(\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{r}\right)=-11\hat{i}-7\hat{j}+12\hat{k}$ को संतुष्ट करता है। तब $\left|\overrightarrow{r}\times\overrightarrow{a}\right|^{2}$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: The given equation becomes $\overrightarrow{r}+(\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{r})\overrightarrow{a}-6\overrightarrow{r}=\overrightarrow{c}$, that is $(\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{r})\overrightarrow{a}-5\overrightarrow{r}=\overrightarrow{c}$.

The unknown scalar $\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{r}$ is found by taking the dot product with $\overrightarrow{a}$: $(\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{r})|\overrightarrow{a}|^2-5(\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{r})=\overrightarrow{a}\cdot\overrightarrow{c}$.
originality_note: New: a linear vector equation r + a x (a x r) = c in which the triple product turns r into a combination of r and a, and one dot product with a collapses the unknown scalar a.r (way 5). Closest known: the standard equation x + (x x a) = b solved by dotting and crossing with a. Different because: here only one dot product is needed and the coefficient 1 - |a|^2 decides solvability; then the answer asks for |r x a|^2.

concept_use.Application of Vector triple product: a x (a x r) = (a.r) a - |a|^2 r turns the equation into (a.r) a - 5 r = c, solved after dotting with a.

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol and object is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Since 1 - |a|^2 = -5 is non-zero, r is unique. Changed: No change.
key_step: Expanding a x (a x r) and dotting with a to find a.r.
justification: Routine chain: triple product expansion, one dot product, back-substitution and |r x a|^2 by Lagrange's identity; no insight beyond the standard expansion. Like 2026-P2-Q1 (L2) in length.
